description: Create a Google Drive folder, optionally nested under a parent folder id. Runs as a background job: dispatch returns a job_id immediately, and the new folder's id arrives via a follow-up message once creation completes. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a new folder in Google Drive as a background job, optionally nested inside an existing parent folder id. Dispatch returns a job_id for tracking; completion delivers the new folder's id, which can be passed as the parent when uploading files or creating further folders, so directory structure gets built up a level at a time.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Job queued for the Drive folder creation; completion will be delivered automatically.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Return exactly one action using the active IO plugin's post_message (process_key: plugin::<io_plugin>::post_message). Use the provided session_id. Keep the message short and friendly. Do NOT invent process identifiers (no present_result, no status actions).

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Dispatch a background job to create a folder in Google Drive.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing name, or missing session_id/flow_id context. gsuite.not_found: the given parent folder id does not exist. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked. gsuite.api_error: AsyncJobManager unavailable or job creation failed.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a folder name. gsuite.not_found: verify the parent id with drive_list_files. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account. gsuite.api_error: retry once platform startup has completed.
